items.contentSnippet:

I created this tool because there were some SQL statements that sqldef couldn't parse.
Pistachio uses pg_query_go.

First time ever, I searched for this template and couldn't find none. Tried Canva, searched for templates, find none either.
Then I designed one from scratch on Canva.
Now, I want others to never design it again.

items.contentSnippet:

The most requested update was macOS support. So it now works on both Linux and macOS.

Thank you again for helping me improve it.
